# Issue templates

This repository uses GitHub Issue Forms to keep reports clear and actionable.

Available templates:

- **Bug report** – Gameplay or UI issues.
- **Crash report** – Game crashes, freezes, or fatal errors.
- **Multiplayer / online issue** – Matchmaking, connectivity, or co-op problems.
- **Performance issue** – Low FPS, stuttering, hitches, and long load times.
- **Feature request** – Ideas for new features or improvements.
- **Documentation issue** – Problems with the docs or in-game help.
- **Question** – Focused questions that don’t fit the above (for most questions, Discussions is preferred).

For general support and back-and-forth conversation, please start in **Discussions** instead of opening an issue:
https://github.com/World-Domination-Software/Projects/discussions
